key_insight: WorldCompass is a post-training RL framework that steers autoregressive, video-based world models to explore and generate more accurate, temporally consistent long-horizon rollouts by evaluating and optimizing multiple clip-level continuation candidates using interaction signals.
problem_solved: Reduces compounding errors and inconsistent behavior in long-horizon, interactive video world models by enabling targeted, reward-driven exploration and selection of better continuations at the clip level.
method: Clip-level rollout strategy: generate multiple candidate continuations for a target clip and evaluate/select among them rather than committing to a single autoregressive sample.
RL-based post-training objective: use interaction/reward signals to score rollouts and update the generation policy (sampling/latent choices) to prefer accurate, consistent trajectories.
Temporal-coherence steering: mechanisms for credit assignment and autoregressive constraint handling to preserve frame-to-frame consistency across long horizons.
impact: Makes long-horizon video world models more reliable for planning and downstream control tasks, improving simulated rollouts, data efficiency, and robustness when models are used interactively or for multi-step decision making.
